title: Introduce jurisdictional audit indexer, KMS-proof collector, and temporal RBAC locks
author: Maya Singh
release_notes: Adds a jurisdictional audit indexer and KMS-proof collector to improve residency traceability; introduces temporal RBAC locks to prevent cross-region elevation. Backwards compatible; opt-in gating for Private installs.
description: Context and motivation: Customers with regulatory requirements have asked for higher-fidelity, queryable proofs that a request was served under a particular jurisdiction and that encryption keys used were consistent with the tenant's region pin. This PR implements a lightweight jurisdictional audit indexer (compact per-tenant shard), a KMS-proof collector that batches and anchors KMS usage proofs into audit envelopes, and a temporal RBAC lock abstraction that prevents short-lived elevation across jurisdiction boundaries. Scope: this change touches the audit pipeline, authz middleware, and the KMS integration layer. It is designed to be backward-compatible for hosted users and opt-in for Private deployments (installer flag: --enable-jurisdictional-audit). Checklist: - [x] Implement audit indexer and storage schema (compact shards + retention knobs) - [x] Add KMS-proof collector that emits verifiable per-batch proofs into envelope v2 - [x] Introduce temporal RBAC lock with TTL and region-bound constraints - [x] Expose token hint header X-Region-Pin for downstream routing and policy evaluation - [x] Add unit + integration tests for indexer, proof collector, and auth path - [x] Update docs & ops runbook for rollout/rollback - [x] Add opt-in installer toggle for Private installs Compatibility notes: Audit envelope v2 is interpreted by the indexer; hosted migration will enable a read-only bridge for existing envelopes for 30 days before enabling full indexing. Private installer will keep the feature disabled by default and expose a migration command. Security considerations: KMS proofs are HMAC-signed with a rotation-aware key; indexer data is stored encrypted-at-rest and tagged with residency metadata. No plaintext keys are stored. Performance: indexer runs asynchronously and uses a bounded in-memory buffer; typical CPU/IO overhead observed in load testing is <3% at p95 traffic patterns. See testing section for numbers. Implementation summary: - services/audit/indexer.go: new indexer service with shard manager and compaction - services/audit/envelope_v2.go: envelope v2 decoder and proof unpacker - pkg/kms/proof_collector.go: KMS batching + signer interface - pkg/rbac/temporal_lock.go: RBAC temporal lock + policy evaluation hooks - middleware/auth/region_pin.go: reads X-Region-Pin and annotates context - migrations/2026_02_jurisdictional_index.sql: DB schema for index metadata - ci/integration/audit-indexer-e2e.yaml: integration pipeline for the indexer and KMS proofs Migration and rollout plan: 1) Merge to main behind a feature flag. 2) Enable feature flag in staging; run indexer against a replay window to validate envelope v2 compatibility. 3) Run canary in a single region for 48 hours with sampling enabled. 4) For hosted customers, enable read-only indexing for 30 days to surface any parsing gaps; run automated recovery for malformed envelopes. 5) For Private customers, operator runs migration command which validates DB schema and enables the indexer. 6) Roll forward to full indexing and enable temporal RBAC locks cluster-wide. Rollback: feature flag off will stop indexing and collector; index metadata remains but will be ignored by API. Related work: builds on ENG-1201 (audit-envelopes) and ENG-2980 (kms-usage-telemetry).

rationale: Provides a minimal, auditable trail tying KMS usage to jurisdictional claims and prevents short-lived cross-region elevation, addressing customer regulatory requirements without large operational overhead.
testing: Unit tests added for parser, collector, and temporal lock. Integration e2e run in a staging cluster with synthetic traffic (10k reqs/min) and no data loss observed. Indexer CPU impact measured at +2.1% p95 and disk IO increase within provisioned IOPS. KMS-proof collector achieved batch signing latency median 6ms; p99 < 50ms. All tests included in ci/integration/audit-indexer-e2e.yaml passed in staging.
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged merge followed by staged enablement: staging -> canary region -> full hosted -> opt-in Private via installer. Monitoring: audit.indexer.parse_errors, audit.indexer.queue_length, kms.proof.sign_latency, rbac.temporal_lock.acquisitions. Rollback: disable flag, collector drains and stops signing, indexer pauses compaction; follow runbook to purge partial indexes if needed.
